results.name: wheel browser input keeps tiny intent idle and uses fixed preset transitions in touch and PC decks

detail.method: Playwright browser wheel input: below-threshold intent leaves geometry idle; normalized 16px and 2000px produce the same preset animation. Physical trackpads remain unverified.

results.name: wheel long inertia tails and 180–350 ms gaps cannot skip cards; fresh reverse bursts navigate

detail.method: Browser wheel input with sustained tails, interrupted tails at 180/250/350ms, deliberate 650ms quiet gaps, reverse commands, and both deck bounds

results.name: wheel line and page delta modes normalize and retain cancellable listener policy

detail.method: Synthetic WheelEvent deltaMode=1/2; actual browser input above covers pixel-mode wheel dispatch

results.name: wheel horizontal intent and control-modified browser zoom input bypass the deck

detail.method: Browser-dispatched horizontal and Control+wheel; browser zoom policy is uncancelled, actual physical pinch scaling remains unverified

results.name: wheel nested scrolling and input controls retain their native paths

detail.method: Browser wheel scrolls a bounded nested overflow fixture; editable input and existing navigation controls remain usable

results.name: wheel contact textarea scrolls while dialog locks deck position

detail.method: Native browser wheel input inside contact textarea; no background card navigation

results.name: wheel desktop, reduced motion, and Read as page keep native document scrolling

detail.method: Browser-dispatched wheel in each normal document flow mode

results.name: wheel lifecycle cancellation clears release timers across blur, resize, reading and reduced motion

detail.method: Native viewport/media/control changes; window blur is explicitly synthetic. Subsequent wheel input verifies no stale gesture/timer interference.

results.name: PC touchscreen and mouse pointer paths work alongside wheel navigation

detail.method: CDP touchscreen input in touch-capable mobile and narrow non-touch PC contexts; physical Windows touchscreen remains unverified

results.name: WebKit desktop/mobile navigation and form smoke
results.message: Skipped because local installed WebKit launch created a context but hung creating its first page and exceeded a 25-second process timeout.

notes: Chromium 149.0.7827.55; installed browser executable explicitly selected.
Firefox, native Safari, Android Chrome, and iPhone Safari are unavailable/unverified in this environment. No real-device performance, browser pinch behavior, or on-screen keyboard claim is made.
